staticMethods.name: Angle
staticMethods.comment:
Returns the draft angle of the face <F> using the direction <Direction>. The method is valid for :
- Plane faces,
- Cylindrical or conical faces, when the direction of the axis of the surface is colinear with the direction. Otherwise, the exception DomainError is raised.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.comment: Changes the basis shape and resets.

instanceMethods.name: Add
instanceMethods.signature: (F: TopoDS_Face, Direction: gp_Dir, Angle: number, NeutralPlane: gp_Pln, Flag?: boolean): boolean
instanceMethods.comment: Adds the face F and propagates the draft modification to its neighbour faces if they are tangent. If an error occurs, will return False and ProblematicShape will return the "bad" face.

instanceMethods.name: Remove
instanceMethods.comment: Removes the face F and the neighbour faces if they are tangent. It will be necessary to call this method if the method Add returns false, to unset ProblematicFace.

instanceMethods.name: Perform
instanceMethods.comment: Performs the draft angle modification and sets the value returned by the method IsDone. If an error occurs, IsDone will return false, and an error status will be given by the method Error, and the shape on which the problem appeared will be given by ProblematicShape.

instanceMethods.name: IsDone
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if Perform has been successfully called. Otherwise more information can be obtained using the methods `Error()` and `ProblematicShape()`.

instanceMethods.name: ProblematicShape
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the shape (Face, Edge or Vertex) on which an error occurred.

instanceMethods.name: ConnectedFaces
instanceMethods.comment: Returns all the faces which have been added together with the face <F>.

instanceMethods.name: ModifiedFaces
instanceMethods.comment: Returns all the faces on which a modification has been given.

instanceMethods.name: NewSurface
instanceMethods.signature: (F: TopoDS_Face, L: TopLoc_Location, Tol: number, RevWires: boolean, RevFace: boolean): { returnValue: boolean; S: Geom_Surface; Tol: number; RevWires: boolean; RevFace: boolean; [Symbol.dispose](): void }
instanceMethods.returnType: { returnValue: boolean; S: Geom_Surface; Tol: number; RevWires: boolean; RevFace: boolean; [Symbol.dispose](): void }
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns true if the face <F> has been modified. In this case, is the new geometric support of the face, <L> the new location, <Tol> the new tolerance.<RevWires> has to be set to true when the modification reverses the normal of the surface. (the wires have to be reversed). <RevFace> has to be set to true if the orientation of the modified face changes in the shells which contain it. Here it will be set to false.
Otherwise, returns false, and , <L>, <Tol> , <RevWires> ,<RevFace> are not significant.
@param L Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.
@returns A result object with fields:
- `returnValue`: the C++ return value
- `S`: owned by the returned envelope.
- `Tol`: updated value from the call.
- `RevWires`: updated value from the call.
- `RevFace`: updated value from the call.
Dispose the returned envelope to release owned Handle fields.

instanceMethods.name: Continuity
instanceMethods.signature: (E: TopoDS_Edge, F1: TopoDS_Face, F2: TopoDS_Face, NewE: TopoDS_Edge, NewF1: TopoDS_Face, NewF2: TopoDS_Face): GeomAbs_Shape
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns the continuity of <NewE> between <NewF1> and <NewF2>.
<NewE> is the new edge created from <E>. <NewF1> (resp. <NewF2>) is the new face created from <F1> (resp. <F2>).
